name: US equity stress
summary: VIX 19.3 and S&P 500 3.3% below its high at the 13 Nov close; both inside Normal lines
state: The VIX closed near 19.3 on 13 Nov, just below the 20 Watch line and 3% lower on the week (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 closed near 7,562, 3.3% below its 52-week high of 7,819 and little changed on the week; its worst session of the past five fell 0.4%. Both readings sit inside the Normal lines.
for_you: US share prices are close to their highs with volatility near average. Pension and investment values linked to US equities are exposed to any renewed swings.
rubric_hit: VIX 19.3 below the 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 3.29% below the 5% Watch line
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
